# Prospective cognate pose extension

Before docking, fix the following new structure–ligand pairs: human EPHX2 4OCZ (the published isobutyrylpiperidine urea) and 6AUM (the published benzoic acid urea), and human PARP1 4R6E (niraparib). Choose the named inhibitor in each deposit. Searches of tracked experiment reports and tables at f46aa37 found no exact PDB identifier for any of the three. Both protein families have appeared previously. This extends chemical/structural validation, not family-level novelty. After unblinding these are longitudinal fixtures. Do not replace failed preparations. Keep the upstream cognate and reciprocal and same-assay panels unchanged.

Use geometry_metric/panel.prepare with its existing nearest-chain selection, 8 Å nonwater omission gate, 6 Å repair gate, CCD stereochemistry, graph-only ETKDGv3 seed 43103 and MMFF start. The known receiver ligand supplies the 24 Å box center and the held-out assessment coordinates. Never align the predicted ligand to the crystal. Record the sources, their hashes, preparation failures/times and prepared inputs before launching prediction. Extracting archived prepared inputs is an alternative to repeating preparation.

Run four compiled engines: official v1.2.7 (8eb40404), genuine parent 05ec6ed, stable f46aa37 and the final candidate. On each eligible case run historical seeds 85231/85237, CPU 1, Vina scoring, three trajectories capped at 12000 evaluations each, nine modes, 100 kcal/mol window, 0.375 Å spacing, default search/refinement/selection. Record all emitted coordinates, costs and failures. A fixed-score API-only correction predicts identical stable/candidate PDBQT including non-first modes. Compare cumulative geometry against each permanent baseline without an assumed improvement direction. For external reference use the minimum whole-heavy-atom displacement over graph-equivalent maps and deposited alternative conformers; report Top-1, Best@5, released-pool minimum, regret, paired changes and conditional distributions. An empty output is a failure with undefined RMSD. Independently recompute from experimental coordinates. No new affinity or free-energy inference on these structures. Cost modes for the main panels are reported separately.
